artifacts_reviewed.review_summary: Comprehensive 10-phase implementation plan with 38 tasks across two packages. Well-structured with clear acceptance criteria and dependency ordering.
Thorough risk assessment: 14 risks (3 CRITICAL, 5 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 2 LOW) with actionable mitigations. 7 external research findings with concrete CVE data and library comparisons.

Comprehensive v3 architecture analysis (802 lines, 19 technical decisions). Produced by respawned architect instance after original stalled. 7-subsystem architecture with detailed component descriptions, file listings, and technical rationale. Aligns with plan's Option D and two-package structure. Key additions over plan: TD-1 (create(stream=True) over .stream()), TD-16 (shared rule assembly extraction — validates SUG-6), TD-18 (settings.json programmatic replication), detailed component interaction flows. 4 open decisions documented (OD-1 through OD-4). V2 reviewer feedback addressed (7 items). Risk cross-references map critical risks to specific TDs. Minor gap: OD-1 recommends markdownify but risk analyst EXT-7 favors html2text on CVE grounds — architect doesn't reference the CVE data.

alignment_with_analysis.details: Plan directly implements the analysis's Option D (Hybrid: Anthropic SDK + raw httpx). Two-package architecture (egg_harness core + egg_harness_integration) matches the analysis's 7-subsystem design. Compaction strategy aligns with Pi-parity requirements. All 12 binding v1 HITL decisions are respected. EGG_HARNESS selection mechanism matches the analysis exactly.

task_breakdown.details: 38 tasks across 10 phases with clear IDs (TASK-1-1 through TASK-10-4). Each task has a description, acceptance criteria, role assignment, and file list. Tasks are appropriately scoped — most are single-file or small-cluster. The YAML task appendix is well-formed and machine-readable.

acceptance_criteria.details: Every task has specific, testable acceptance criteria. Examples: 'unit tests for all standard tools pass' (TASK-3-3), 'compaction fires when context_tokens > threshold and reduces conversation size by >50%' (TASK-5-2). Criteria are objective rather than subjective.

dependency_ordering.details: Phases follow a logical bottom-up sequence: Foundation (types, config) → Providers → Tools → Agent Loop → Context Management → Prompt Assembly → Client API → Integration → Harness Selection → Cross-cutting Tests. Parallelism is correctly identified where phases are independent. Dependencies section in each phase is accurate.

risk_assessment.details: Risk analyst produced a thorough assessment. Three CRITICAL risks correctly identified: tool behavioral parity (RISK-1), credential flow integrity (RISK-2), context management (RISK-3). Human review gates (HRG-1 through HRG-6) are well-defined. Cross-cutting concerns (CC-1 through CC-5) capture systemic issues. See suggestions below for integration gaps between risk assessment and plan.

test_strategy.details: Plan includes dedicated test tasks per phase (TASK-1-3, TASK-2-3, TASK-3-3, TASK-4-3, TASK-5-3, TASK-10-1 through TASK-10-4). Test strategy section covers unit tests, integration tests, and manual testing. Compliance test suite for tool behavioral parity is explicitly planned (TASK-10-2).

completeness.details: Plan covers all major subsystems from the analysis. However, several gaps identified between the risk assessment recommendations and the plan's tasks. See suggestions below.

suggestions.title: markdownify vs html2text discrepancy
suggestions.description: Risk analyst EXT-7 recommends html2text over markdownify based on CVE analysis (zero CVEs vs one CVE for markdownify, simpler dependency tree). The plan references markdownify in TASK-3-1 (via decision-3 from HITL). This is a non-blocking discrepancy — the HITL decision predates the risk analyst's external research. Recommend raising as a follow-up HITL decision to reconsider the library choice.

suggestions.title: Missing documentation tasks
suggestions.description: No tasks for creating README.md files for the new packages (shared/egg_harness/README.md and shared/egg_harness_integration/README.md). The project convention has READMEs for every major package (see shared/egg_agent/README.md, shared/egg_anchor/README.md, etc.). Recommend adding a documentation task in Phase 9 or 10.

suggestions.title: Missing Makefile/CI integration tasks
suggestions.description: No tasks for updating the root Makefile to include new packages in 'make test', 'make lint', 'make security' targets. Also no CI workflow updates (e.g., .github/workflows/). These are needed for the packages to be included in standard development and CI workflows.

suggestions.title: Compaction anti-loop threshold discrepancy
suggestions.description: Plan specifies compaction anti-loop guard of 3 turns (if compaction fires twice within 3 turns, abort). Risk analyst M-3-3 recommends 5 turns. This is a minor implementation detail but should be reconciled to avoid confusion during implementation. The risk analyst's reasoning (5 turns gives more room for recovery) is sound.

suggestions.title: Max retries discrepancy
suggestions.description: Plan specifies max_retries=3 for streaming error recovery. Risk analyst M-3-6 recommends 5. Minor difference but should be reconciled.

suggestions.title: Missing shared rule assembly function extraction
suggestions.description: Risk analyst M-7-1 recommends extracting the CLAUDE.md/settings.json assembly logic from sandbox/entrypoint.py into a shared function that both entrypoint.py and the harness can call. Plan's TASK-8-2 replicates the behavior instead of extracting it. Extraction would reduce duplication and ensure consistent rule merging.

suggestions.title: Session redaction not addressed in context management
suggestions.description: Risk analyst RISK-9 M-9-3 recommends applying checkpoint redaction patterns to session persistence files. Plan's TASK-5-3 (session persistence) does not mention redaction. Session files could contain sensitive context that should be redacted before persistence.

overall_assessment: The plan is high quality and ready for implementation. All three producers delivered substantive artifacts. The task_planner produced a well-structured 10-phase plan with 38 tasks implementing Option D (Hybrid). The risk_analyst provided thorough external research (14 risks, 7 external findings with CVE data). The architect (respawned after original stall) produced a comprehensive v3 architecture analysis with 19 technical decisions, detailed component interaction flows, and explicit v2 feedback resolution. The architect's output validates and strengthens the plan — the 7-subsystem architecture, two-package structure, and HITL decision integration all align. The architect adds valuable implementation detail (TD-1: streaming method choice, TD-16: shared rule assembly extraction, TD-18: settings.json handling). Seven non-blocking suggestions remain — the architect's output resolves none but validates SUG-6 (shared rule assembly) as architecturally important (TD-16).
